question: Which ministry introduced the Press and Registration of Periodicals (PRP) Bill in Rajya Sabha on 1 August 2023?

options.text: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Information and Broadcasting**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Press and Registration of Periodicals (PRP) Bill** was introduced in the Rajya Sabha on **1 August 2023** by the **Ministry of Information and Broadcasting**.
